source_profile: Aggregated panel signal across Shark Tank - Millennials (2026-08-26), Peloton - Millennials (2026-08-26), Furious Viewers - Millennials (2026-08-28), HAZBIN HOTEL / HELLUVA BOSS / KPOP DEMON HUNTERS / CHILLING ADVENTURES OF SABRINA - Millennials cuts.
one_line: US adults 29 to 44. Nostalgia-forward, career-and-mortgage-and-daycare anxious, prestige-TV loyal, heavy podcast consumer, AmEx-and-Chase-Sapphire spender, DTC-and-Costco shopper, Peloton / Oura / Whoop wearer, still on Instagram but pulled to TikTok, Bluey parent.

demographics.age_range: 29 to 44. Density in 35-44 (idx 439) with a strong 25-34 tail (idx 245). 18-24 and 45+ fall below 3.
demographics.gender_skew: Roughly 50 male / 47 female, with non-binary and trans identifiers present but at lower share than Gen Z. Read as gender-balanced with a slight female pull on wellness, parenting, and BookTok surfaces and a slight male pull on sports-fandom, gaming, and finance-podcast surfaces.
demographics.income_band: Every income band sits near index 100 to 105. This is the peak spender-power decade: mortgages, daycare, salary progression, DINK dual-income and single-parent both present. HHI median leans $85K to $110K with a fat long tail into $150K-plus.
demographics.education: Bachelors idx 142, Graduate idx 139, Some College 113, HS or less 48. Read as college-educated majority with graduate-degree lift, but keep the trade-and-associate slice honest (they exist).
demographics.occupation_skew: Management, business, and professional idx 123, STEM idx 135, Healthcare 82. Read as the career-building decade. Sales / service under-indexes vs Gen Z because the cohort has aged out of those roles.
demographics.ethnicity_skew: White 96, Hispanic 121, Black 109, Asian 104. Read as a majority-non-white-adjacent cohort, more diverse than Gen X but less than Gen Z.
demographics.life_stage: Married 122, In a relationship 222, Single 66. Has children under 12 in the home idx 148. This is the daycare, first-house, first-real-vacation, first-real-401k decade. Also the peak divorce-and-restart decade (idx 65 for divorced trending up into Gen X).

values: Nostalgia as identity. Grew up with the 90s and 2000s. Cobra Kai / Barbie / Marvel / Star Wars / HOTD / Ted Lasso were built for them.
Anxiety-first framing. Mortgage rates, daycare costs, IVF, student-loan payments, screen-time guilt, sandwich-generation caregiving all real.
Wellness-informed but tired. Oura Ring 245, Whoop, Peloton, Barry's, F45, Weight Watchers 811, Headspace 1,116, Calm 703 all over-index. Sober-curious rising.
DTC-and-Costco same-cart. Little Hunter and Purina both in the cabinet, Whole Foods for the parts that photograph well, Costco for the parts that do not.
Podcast-first news habit. The Daily, SmartLess, Armchair Expert, Call Her Daddy, Huberman, Diary of a CEO, How I Built This, Ringer NBA network.
Career-plus-parent identity braid. LinkedIn 239 and TheBump 474 and Instagram 182 all on the same phone.

psychographics.tone_they_respond_to: First-person, self-deprecating, slightly-tired, aware of the meme. Willing to admit the mortgage payment is scary and the daycare bill is scarier. Cracks a joke about therapy, not about anyone else. Prestige-TV recap voice. Podcast-host register.
psychographics.tone_they_reject: Boomer cable-news anchor voice, gotcha political theater, Gen Z hyper-native slang without a Millennial rearticulation, evangelical prosperity, MLM, alpha-bro grindset, Andrew Tate style content, Fox News framing on entertainment or parenting.

KEEP AI stories that touch productivity, work, journaling, or family (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Notion AI, GitHub Copilot). Drop AI stories that are pure enterprise-earnings or GPU-supply-chain.
KEEP Latin crossover (Bad Bunny, Karol G, Peso Pluma) and Black-women-in-media (Taraji P Henson, Ayo Edebiri, Coco Jones, Halle Bailey, Simone Biles, Angel Reese, WNBA coverage).

KEEP Netflix / Hulu / HBO Max / Apple TV+ / Peacock / Prime Video release calendar items whose lead cast reads as prestige TV. Drop kids-only animation without adult crossover unless it is Bluey-tier.
DROP hustle-culture, grindset, Andrew Tate, alpha-bro, wall-street-alpha, get-rich-quick trading-guru content.

DROP openly conservative culture-war messaging: Ben Shapiro, Tucker Carlson, Matt Walsh, Charlie Kirk, Candace Owens, PragerU, Turning Point USA, evangelical prosperity, Christian Nationalist framing.
DROP boomer cable-news anchor personality drama (Sean Hannity, Jesse Watters, Greg Gutfeld) unless it hit the Ringer / Ezra Klein register.
DROP AARP, Medicare Supplement, retirement community, life-alert, senior-caregiver content, cruise-line marketing (Viking, Holland America, Princess).
DROP Great American Family, Hallmark Channel, TBN, Pure Flix, 700 Club, and Christian-market book coverage.
DROP NASCAR unless it is the Netflix Full Speed moment, Trackhouse Racing collabs, or a Chase Elliott / Kyle Larson crossover story.
DROP legacy country outside the pop-crossover moment: Morgan Wallen, Post Malone country, Zach Bryan pass; Rascal Flatts, Florida Georgia Line, Dierks Bentley, Blake Shelton do not for most.
DROP Fox Business / Newsmax / NewsNation framing on any topic. Drop CNBC unless the item is personal-finance or a specific tech-earnings the cohort cares about (Apple, Nvidia, Netflix).

TIE-BREAK when unsure: does this item touch nostalgia, parenting, mortgage-and-money, wellness stack, prestige TV, or a Millennial-coded talent? If yes, lean KEEP. If it reads as content aimed at their grandparents or their toddler, lean DROP.
expected_kept_share_per_tab: 30-50% of items per tab. Podcasts, songs, books, films, and streaming all skew higher because this is the peak-consumption decade. Headlines and searches narrow harder because a lot of the philanthropy and business-earnings items are not core-audience.
